existing_components.description: Loads openai/clip-vit-base-patch32, extracts 512-dim normalized pooler embeddings, computes cosine similarity against precomputed catalog centroids, and validates dataset SHA256 cache integrity.
Extracts raw text from image uploads using EasyOCR, identifies brand and product names, and applies OCR confidence thresholds.

Calculates weighted multi-modal ensemble authenticity score combining OCR confidence (30%), CLIP similarity (40%), review trust (20%), and image resolution integrity (10%). Note: CLIP similarity and sentiment scores are visual/text matching indicators, not physical authenticity proofs.

Evaluates review trust scores, rating distributions, and verified buyer ratios using a brand lookup dictionary (CeraVe, L'Oreal, The Ordinary, etc.) with default fallback. Note: Review sentiment is not proof of review authenticity.
Computes transparent multi-factor platform comparison scores using documented weights: Review Trust (40%), Rating Score (25%), Seller Trust (20%), Product Match Confidence (15%).
Orchestrates concurrent queries to Amazon, Daraz, and Temu via ThreadPoolExecutor. Captures anti-bot HTTP 403/503/429 blocks cleanly with source_status='blocked' or 'unavailable'.
Evaluates normalized token overlap across Brand (35%), Product Name (40%), Product Type (15%), and Variant/Shade (10%) to output 'Exact Product Match', 'Possible Match', or 'Not a Match'.
Accepts multipart form file uploads via Multer, validates file size and non-empty status, and stores files in backend/uploads.

GET /api/v1/products/{product_id}/listings (Retrieve cached & verified marketplace listings for a product)

review_analysis_findings.current_implementation: Dictionary lookup based on brand name (DEFAULT_BRAND_TRUST_METRICS) returning trust_score, sentiment_label, average_rating, and verified_buyer_percentage.
review_analysis_findings.scientific_disclaimer: Review sentiment analysis evaluates customer opinion and expression patterns. High positive sentiment IS NOT proof of physical product authenticity or review authenticity (fake reviews can be overly positive).
review_analysis_findings.recommended_enhancement: Integrate lightweight NLP transformer (e.g. cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest) and deceptive review pattern heuristics (burst detection, unverified buyer weighting).

risks.description: Automated HTML web scraping without API authorization may violate marketplace Terms of Service or trigger IP bans.
Marketplaces actively employ CAPTCHAs, Cloudflare, and JS rendering checks, causing frequent HTTP 403/503 blocks.
Unverified seller listings or mislabeled marketplace titles can pollute comparison scores if not filtered by product matching thresholds.
CLIP visual similarity measures visual packaging resemblance to catalog centroids. It CANNOT verify physical bottle contents or detect sophisticated counterfeit packaging.
API keys for official marketplace services or proxy providers must be stored in .env and never committed to version control.
